title: SUCCESSION Walking Tour - Uptown & Downtown NYC Filming Locations
includes: Gratuities are gratefully accepted. "That goes unsaid. But it's not unsaid if you say it." (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Didn’t get enough of HBO’s SUCCESSION? Still yearn to talk about Logan Roy, Kendall, Roman and Shiv? Our memories of Succession live on through this fascinating tour. Yes they are horrible people, but we are still enthralled to see where they live, work and scheme. Now’s the time to cherish the show’s prodigious writing and acting by booking a walking tour of filming locations in Manhattan, yeah? 

Visit uptown and downtown locations back to back on the same day or savor the experience and book each tour separately on different days.

Even if you "pre-grieved" the ending of SUCCESSION you will enjoy reliving everything you loved about the show! An experienced tour guide will be showing you memorable filming locations while at the same time you'll be passing by important Manhattan places that are the backdrop to the lives of these ultra-wealthy media moguls. Clearly a splendid way to tour the big apple even for those who didn't see the tv show.
